brief: A 6.8-magnitude earthquake in Japan traps dozens in a shopping mall and damages Kumamoto Castle, while France and Spain battle wildfires amid a heatwave. Political upheaval within the Heritage Foundation and reflections on COVID-19 origins via Fauci's diary also feature.
news_summary: Japan earthquake injures 50 and traps people in Kumamoto; France and Spain race to control wildfires as heatwave hits. US politics sees Graham's funeral with Netanyahu and Zelenskyy, plus Heritage Foundation's internal conflict and Fauci's diary release.
papers_summary: Papers explore explainable AI in code review, visualization of contour ensembles, and mental imagery in icon design for fire risks. Other works cover quantum circuit visualizations, multimodal data comprehension, and LLMs aiding blind users with charts.

zh.brief: 唐山大地震50周年纪念引发对历史与现实的反思；香港前议员胡志伟赴英遭扣留后获准停留；日本熊本县发生6.8级地震，多人被困。
zh.news_summary: 唐山大地震50周年，多篇报道回顾灾难细节与社会影响；香港前议员胡志伟赴英被扣后获准停留；日本熊本县6.8级地震致多人被困，九州电力报告4.8万户停电。

todays_image.caption: Both the 1906 San Francisco earthquake and today's Japanese earthquake involve shattered structures—one a mailbox, another a shopping centre—that once held messages and lives now trapped in rubble.
todays_image.title: Mailbox remnant from 1906 San Francisco earthquake
